title: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (device songshan, product songshan_emH_FFM, board m7632, MediaTek),
header:
Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (device songshan, product songshan_emH_FFM, board m7632, MediaTek),
Android 11 / SDK 30, firmware RTT2.220118.001 / 01.00.05.04. The Android model string is
"SmartTV 4K FFM".

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm-android11/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm-android11/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED with pm disable-user, never uninstalled.

Android 11 sibling of examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm/ (Android TV 10, device huangshan): same model
string, different board and firmware and a different package set (no evservice, no hotel mode, no
tvrecommendations here). Applied in two batches with a reboot after; no crashes, normal boot.

WARNING, shared with the huangshan FFM list: never disable com.hisense.tv.smartsense,
com.vt.tv.smartsense.ui or com.vt.tv.aiot. A version of the huangshan list that did sent the set to
Android Recovery on the next boot ("Can't load Android system"). They are kept out below.

Keep: com.mediatek.* (including com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, the Live TV and HDMI app),
com.hisense.tv.hitvinput and com.mediatek.tv.service (they serve TvInputService and ask for
TV_INPUT_HARDWARE, so the HDMI/AV/tuner inputs depend on them), com.hisense.tv.smartservice,
com.hisense.tv.customerlauncher, com.vt.tv.input, com.hisense.tv.protector.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (the Google TV home). It is disabled by the
launcher install, not by this list; pass it to tools/restore.sh as the stock launcher.
Already disabled at the factory on this set: YouTube Music, Google TV Movies, Feedback, Play Games,
HiBrowser, TalkBack, TTS, mediashell, basic dreams, calendar/contacts providers, Kika keyboard.
Left ON by choice here (deliberately not in this list): all streaming apps, voice assistant
(katniss / tv.assistant / hisense.alexa), casting and mirroring, and the firmware updaters
(hisense.tv.ota, hisense.remoteupgrade, vt.tv.usbota).

sections.title: Google partner auto-install stub (silent partner app installs)
On-screen disclaimer app (removed from the app grid)
Google TV setup wizard
sections.note: Its RecoveryActivity claims HOME and beats the new launcher once com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx is disabled, so it has to go for a launcher swap. It also owns a saved Wi-Fi network, so check first: `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'`. If the network the TV is actually connected to belongs to setupwraith, forget and re-join it in Settings before running this, or the disable deletes that network and takes the TV off Wi-Fi and ADB. On this set only an unused saved network belonged to it (the active one was owned by android.uid.system), so it was safe. Needs FORCE_SETUPWRAITH=1 to pass disable.sh's Wi-Fi guard.
